cs.t: I thought i learned to forget how to type. knew i wasn't going crazy. edit: another apple issue i have been hearing about recently is that the apple watch alarm just doesn't work some days. i have no idea why. i don't have silent mode on when it happens. i have tried so many different settings to fix it. ended up buying the hatch alarm.
